name: beauclick/b2b
description: BeauClick B2B — business accounts, tiered wholesale pricing, MOQ, and quotes. Custom (not a third-party plugin) after review: the free tiers of the popular WooCommerce wholesale plugins don't include tiered quantity pricing or MOQ (paywalled add-ons), and this environment has no way to purchase/license one. Built directly on WooCommerce's own pricing hooks, same pattern any of those plugins would use internally.
